question.text: ROE and ROA are metrics used in which EIC step?

explanation.text: The Logic: The source workbook lists ROE (return on equity) and ROA (return on assets) under Company Analysis and describes them as signals of efficient use of capital. That places them at the company step of the Economy-Industry-Company framework. The Trap: Economic and Industry steps focus on macro and sector-level drivers, not firm-specific returns on capital. "None - they are macro" misclassifies firm-level profitability ratios as economy-wide indicators. Note: Only the company-analysis placement and efficient-use-of-capital interpretation are anchored to the cited page; any cost-of-equity comparison or excess-value-creation framing requires a separately cited source.
